# §5 — The Six Determinations

## #0 — The conscious circumstance enters the worked copula

The input is lived `0/1`, received through the already explicated slash `/ = ( = =/≠ ≠ )`. The operation is to derive the qualitative relations through which this knowing-act becomes accountable. The sixfold count alone does not supply those meanings.

The [Binary Explication house](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md), File 1 §5, sources the line-by-line development through its poem. The [core-theorems spine](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md), §II(c), curates the determination sequence. The [root spine-index](../../eight-determinations.md) gathers their twelvefold setting.

## #1 — Ground becomes answerable

**0/1 — Ground.** Awareness is the condition in which following, consequence, and appearance are given. It is encountered through what appears while remaining unobjectifiable as another appearing term. The poem's first line relates being beyond consequence to being consequential in every appearance.

**?/! — Definition.** Once something appears, it calls for account. Asking what it is has already made a provisional mark; asserting an answer remains exposed to whether it runs true. The second line, concerning what allows an essence, refuses to promote that enabling condition into one further essence.

The transition is necessary to the operation: a present field becomes an accountable field through the question and mark it can sustain.

## #2 — The mark gains force and recurrence

**−/+ — Dynamis.** A mark makes a difference by withholding and issuing. The poem's journey and residence hold extension with reserve in one pulse. The positive appears through the ground's own self-relation, rather than being imported as an independently existing opposite.

**X/x — Pattern.** Force becomes recognisable when it can recur. The temporal particular *x* makes its determining capacity *X* legible; one letter in two cases preserves their relation. The poem's sojourning and presiding conduct this difference. The small *x* also carries multiplication: an instance can compound and generate further instances.

The transition gives movement a recognisable form without removing the force through which that form lives.

## #3 — Pattern is personed and opens a horizon

**AM/IS — Context.** A recurring form is lived from within. First-person presence and third-person describability meet through second-person relation. The poem's total yet incidental context is the world accompanying every appearance without ordinarily appearing as one more object.

**∞/dx — Realisation.** No finite context exhausts the field in which knowing occurs. The differential makes local change exact; the unbounded names the depth no local mark contains. The poem's silence and reverence articulate this precision without possession.

The transition gives personed knowledge its continuing answerability. The result is a complete qualitative body, rather than six interchangeable metaphors for awareness.

## #4 — Brackets, harmonics, and folds

The parent `−/−` precedes these six qualitative determinations. The return `1/0` turns their achieved expression towards its ground. Together they give eight turns, **(4+2)+2**, while the interior positional body remains six.

The forward harmonics pair Ground/Definition as Being, Dynamis/Pattern as Becoming, and Context/Realisation as Knowing/unKnowing. Complementary folds pair `0+5` as Essence, `1+4` as Constitution, and `2+3` as Text–Texture. These relations make the sequence traversable and cross-readable. They do not identify the six qualitative meanings with every source's slash-form table: `?/!` at qualitative #1 and incomputability at processual #3 retain their different offices.

## #5→0 — The foundation is recognised through finding

The poem's closing movement says that the foundation of mind remains unfound by the mental. Every act of finding already operates through the condition it seeks to make into an object. [1/0](../../1-0.md) returns the achieved articulation through this recognition. File 1 closes on its short definitional chain; process and music carry the full inverse-phase circuit.

The [Catuṣkoṭi crossing](catuskoti-crossing.md) extends how these relations change from descriptions into lived recognition. This projection returns-to [A18](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) and [Movement25](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/25-s3-p0-eight-determinations.md), retaining every determination's exact place in the whole.
